title: ZE17 — test pióro: kabina → grill
description: Test przejścia f241 → f289 (10–12 s previsu). Generacja 3 s, planowane odtwarzanie ×1,5. Start i End pochodzą z frame-studies-v002; wyłącznie techniczne przeskalowanie do1080p. Bez zmian timeline. Dokładne prompty obrazów i ich pierwotne referencje: _system/frame-studies-v002/jobs/f0241-v001.json oraz f0289-v001.json.

prompts.image:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Generate a NEW single photorealistic live-action movie frame from the ORIGINAL references, never an edit of an earlier generated frame. 16:9 landscape, target1920x1080. The FIRST image is the authoritative Blender spatial blueprint. Its camera extrinsics, projection, crop, perspective, silhouettes, object positions and relative scales are LOCKED. Build realistic surfaces and shapes INSIDE those projected envelopes. Do not improve the composition, reframe, enlarge people, move the feather, or substitute the viewpoint of supporting photos. In particular match the single white feather's visible contour, angle, center and endpoints exactly. It is a normal 36cm feather close to camera, not an enormous object in the environment. Preserve the depth relationship foreground feather / background scene. Reference photos supply ONLY identity, clothing, vehicle design and real Poznań materials as specified below. Consistent early evening blue dusk, restrained warm lamps and lit windows, believable natural photographic detail. No plastic CGI, no fantasy architecture, no watermark, no captions, no invented prominent people. Primitives are spatial proxies, NOT literal cubic buildings/people/vehicles. Anatomically correct humans and mechanically plausible objects. OUTPUT ONLY ONE IMAGE. Spatial fidelity takes priority over beauty.
The burgundy seated block figure is Estebes, NOT a mannequin. Image2 locks face and high dark wavy hair/short beard. Image3 supplies burgundy robe with gold ornaments, black collar/cuffs, white undershirt, chain, and canonical burgundy-gold GRUZAR cab materials. Image4 is the actual GRUZAR steering wheel: use its construction, not its viewpoint. Image5 real Poznań for only distant background. Camera OUTSIDE driver side, Estebes in LEFT-facing profile driving, door CLOSED, slight reflections must not hide his face. Replace the primitive limbs with exactly two anatomical arms; two distinct normal hands hold opposite parts of ONE rigid round steering wheel, appearing as a coherent narrow ellipse from this oblique side view. Five digits per hand with realistic occlusion, no duplicate/merged fingers or broken/double rim. Forearms must connect from robe cuffs to wrists naturally, no crossing/intersecting arms. Near hand lower-near quadrant, far hand upper-far quadrant. Wheel plane faces driver, not camera; normal inclined truck steering column. Seat remains behind his torso. Tall grey object far left is mirror housing; black circles on far right are speaker cones in chrome tower. Roof pipe proxies become chrome horns. Cream block at right is mixer drum. Use real cab side window dimensions, leave original spatial envelopes intact. Feather is outside glass, never on seat or driver's body. No facial turn towards camera, no smiling portrait pose.
Strict frame241: camera slightly LOWER relative to driver than previous sequence; roof is cropped at top, no entire roof/horns visible. Driver hair top14%, head center38%,25%, chin34%; torso center36%,50%; wheel center20%,50%. Rear pillar x73%, window sill diagonal fromleft93% to right75%. Feather bbox x47–55%,y30–67%, tip UP-RIGHT x53%,y30%, quill DOWN-LEFT x47%,y67%. Feather in front of seat but OUTSIDE glass. Driver lower legs/cream clogs partly visible bottom-left as in blueprint, don't enlarge torso or move head down to make a portrait. At far right chrome tower shows THREE cropped speaker cones. Exact Blender camera, crop and locations are mandatory.
prompts.endFrameDescription: Pióro przed grillem tej samej jadącej betoniarki.
prompts.animation: 0–3s: The single feather is already drifting outside the driver's window. It floats toward the truck's front, initially screen left, then descends around the exterior front corner into the space ahead of the grille, arriving at the supplied End Frame. Camera: one continuous tracking move follows the feather around the cab, staying outside the vehicle. Gentle airflow makes the feather flutter and roll; its apparent size decreases naturally as it moves farther from the lens. The truck keeps driving straight, initially toward screen left, with roadside structures passing rearward. The driver watches the road with both hands on the wheel. Preserve the driver's identity, feather, rigid truck geometry, ornaments, lettering and dusk lighting. No cuts, dissolves, morphing, duplicates, extra limbs or passage through solid surfaces. Use @Image1 only for the design and structural continuity of the same truck already present, never its studio background or lighting.
